about: Words CONTEXT.md's glossary says to avoid, kept out of src/, docs/ and CONTEXT.md by scripts/checks/glossary.mjs. Each says what to write instead. Add a word only where every use of it is wrong: the glossary also avoids everyday words (line, stop, path) that are right elsewhere.
